en.headline: Joint task force arrests 28 in first bid-rigging operation after Tai Po fire
en.dek: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the suspected triad-linked syndicate targeted at least 20 buildings with awarded and pending contracts worth about HK$200 million.
body: Authorities arrested 28 people on Friday in the first operation by a joint task force formed after the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po, targeting a suspected triad-linked bid-rigging syndicate in building maintenance and renovation projects.

Secretary for Security Chris Tang said the syndicate had already secured contracts worth about HK$100 million across 12 buildings and was pursuing a further HK$100 million in eight more. Those arrested included directors and staff from a property management company, six contractors and 10 consultancy firms, plus one owners’ corporation member. Some were suspected of having triad backgrounds.

Tang said the group had sought to rush contracts before new anti-bid-rigging measures took effect, using pretexts such as material price changes. The task force, comprising police, the Independent Commission Against Corruption and the Competition Commission, has set up a 24-hour hotline at 182000 for reports. Officials will contact affected owners’ corporations to offer assistance. Separately, police raided seven suspected triad premises and arrested 38 people.

zh.headline: 聯合特遣隊首次行動瓦解圍標集團 拘28人
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示，涉案集團疑與三合會有關，針對最少20幢樓宇，已批及待批合約共約兩億元。
body: 當局周五在大埔宏福苑火災後成立的聯合特遣隊首次行動中，拘捕28人，打擊一個疑與三合會有關的樓宇維修及翻新工程圍標集團。
保安局局長鄧炳強表示，該集團已取得12幢樓宇約一億元合約，並正爭取另外八幢樓宇約一億元工程。被捕人士包括物業管理公司董事及職員、六間承建商及十間顧問公司的人員，以及一名業主立案法團成員。部分人疑有三合會背景。
鄧炳強指集團試圖在新的反圍標措施生效前趕簽合約，以材料價格波動等借口催促業主。特遣隊由警方、廉政公署及競爭事務委員會組成，已設立24小時舉報熱線182000。當局會聯絡受影響的業主立案法團提供協助。另外，警方搗破七個疑受三合會控制的非法場所，拘捕38人。
